messages:
Maya - AE: Quick sync — big EU bank wants a 2-day POC next week. Requirements: strict EU data residency for all request/response payloads, visibility of sub-processors for their vendor review, BYOK demo flow, and a back-of-envelope cost compare for a small Dedicated pool vs hosted metered. They want to sign NDA today and test Tue/Wed. Can we confirm whether a hosted demo with BYOK-ish flow is safe, and what the blockers are?

Owen - Solutions Eng: Short: doable. Two paths: (A) Hosted demo with a simulated BYOK flow (no on-prem key material stored outside our platform) or (B) Dedicated trial (real KMS integration + customer key control). Hosted demo is fastest; Dedicated gives true BYOK but needs infra lead time.

Priya - Infra: For strict EU pinning we can bind control + compute to eu-west-1 and eu-central-1. Routing policy supports tenant_pin + preferred_regions. If capacity is exhausted we can either reject or failover to Dedicated/standby region depending on policy. Note: KV cache and model weights warming across regions -> expect cold-start latency when failing over.

Nora - Security: Subproc list: primary compute (MajorCloud EU), blob storage (BlobCo EU), observability (MetricsSAAS EU). I'll export the formal subproc CSV and add our EU data processing addendum. Hosted BYOK: we support a "soft BYOK" demo path (ephemeral escrow) but production BYOK requires either Dedicated or Private with customer KMS and an attestation step (~2-3 business days).

Maya - AE: They insisted on seeing actual BYOK for demo. The procurement/legal team may accept an escrowed demo if it's documented. Is the 2-3 day attestation going to block Tue/Wed?

Owen - Solutions Eng: For a demo we can do this: customer uploads key material to a time-limited escrow bucket (documented), we configure the hosted demo to use that key for the session only. We ship a small runbook and delete keys after the POC. Label as non-production BYOK. For production, recommend Dedicated.

Priya - Infra: Cost roughs (very approximate):
- Hosted (metered): assume 50 req/s, avg 350 tokens/request: ~ $4k-$9k/month (token-mix dependent).
- Dedicated POC (reserve small pool, EU GPUs): $20k-$28k/month commit. Add one-off KMS integration/attestation fee (engineering time) ~$5k.
Numbers include no legal/compliance SOW.

Nora - Security: Legal review note: subproc CSV + DPA addendum typically needs ~4 business days for enterprise sign-off. If they need SCC review faster, escalate to LegalOps. Private deployment for absolute EU-only (no third-party subprocs) takes weeks and requires procurement.

Maya - AE: OK. Customer willingness: they can accept a screen-share demo with escrowed keys for now, but procurement wants the subproc inventory today. Action items?

Owen - Solutions Eng: I'll prepare a minimal demo config and a sample routing_policy snippet for them to review: 
```
routing_policy:
  tenant_pin: "eu-only"
  prefer_regions: ["eu-central-1", "eu-west-1"]
  fallback: "reject"  # options: reject | route-dedicated | route-hosted-fallback
  kms_mode: "escrow-demo"  # demo-only flag, not for production
```

Priya - Infra: Created ticket INF-9102 to reserve a 2-node EU Dedicated pool Tue/Wed for the POC. ETA for confirmation: later today. Also note: if we link Dedicated as fallback, we need to pre-warm KV caches to avoid 10-20s tail latencies. Include warmup script in runbook.

ops-bot: Runbook stub created: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/poc-eu-byo/1750012345 — includes steps to toggle fallback, the warmup script, and key escrow cleanup checklist.

Nora - Security: I'll DM LegalOps and attach the subproc CSV and a short slide explaining the escrow demo controls and deletion guarantees. Also: recommend we append an LOA that escrowed keys are single-use and destroyed after POC.

Maya - AE: Nice. Next steps: 1) Nora to post subproc CSV and LOA draft, 2) Owen to deliver demo config + email instructions for escrow flow, 3) Priya to confirm Dedicated capacity hold, 4) I will send NDA + timing to customer. Target: send package by EOD.

Owen - Solutions Eng: I'll also include a sample SOW line item for KMS integration labor and note the expected attestation lead time.

Priya - Infra: INF-9102 updated: hold confirmed (soft hold) pending final approval. If they pick Dedicated we'll convert to a hard reserve.

Maya - AE: Thanks everyone — I'll circle back after NDA. Closing thread until we have legal and infra confirmations. :white_check_mark:
